SecureInstructions.inst_a01: Walk straight down the corridor, then take a right turn at the black lounge seating.
SecureInstructions.inst_a02: Walk towards the exit, passing the lounge seating on your left side.
SecureInstructions.inst_a03: Continue past the coffee station, then take the door on your left marked with the elevator symbol.
SecureInstructions.inst_a04: Exit the elevator lobby and immediately turn right towards the coffee station.
SecureInstructions.inst_a05: Take the elevator or the stairs up to the next floor level.
SecureInstructions.inst_a06: Take the elevator or the stairs down to the previous floor level.
SecureInstructions.inst_a07: Exit the elevator lobby and take a right turn in the corridor. Conference Room Gripen is located on the left side, directly opposite the large plant.
SecureInstructions.inst_a08: Exit the room, turn right, and follow the corridor straight ahead until you reach the glass doors of the elevator lobby.
SecureInstructions.inst_a09: Turn immediately left after the security gates and follow the narrow corridor to the door at the end.
SecureInstructions.inst_a10: Walk to the end of the corridor and turn right to return to the reception and main entrance.
SecureInstructions.inst_a11: Walk past the coffee station and continue through the double doors into the lunchroom.
SecureInstructions.inst_a12: Exit the lunchroom through the double doors and walk straight ahead towards the coffee station.
SecureInstructions.inst_a13: Exit the room, turn left, and follow the corridor to the gray door leading into the elevator lobby.
SecureInstructions.inst_a14: Exit the elevator lobby through the gray door, turn right, and follow the corridor to the door at the end.
SecureInstructions.inst_a15: Turn right just before the coffee station and walk to the door at the end of the short hallway.
SecureInstructions.inst_a16: Exit the room, turn left, and walk up to the corridor intersection by the coffee station.
SecureInstructions.inst_a17: Exit the elevator lobby, take a left turn in the corridor, and follow it to the very last door on the right side.
SecureInstructions.inst_a18: Exit the room, turn left, and follow the corridor straight ahead until you see the doors to the elevator lobby.
